# MetaBlooms Charter (Draft — Generated)

## Authority
This bundle is a portable state handoff for MetaBlooms work.

## Non-Negotiable North-Star Invariants (evidence-backed)
- Artifact-First Governance
- Chats Are Source Code
- Zero-Manual Automation
- Durable Memory via Replay
- Education-Native Outcomes
- Scalable Reuse by Others

## Operating Principle
- OS artifacts are authoritative.
- Claims require same-turn evidence.
- Fail-closed when required evidence is missing.

## Handoff Protocol
See: `Bootstrap/REPLAY_BOOTSTRAP_PROTOCOL.md`
